name: Oregon LNG Bidirectional Pipeline
researcher_notes: Checked the existing United States gas roster. No row matches. Pacific Connector (P0237) is a different line. The sponsor is Oregon Pipeline Company, owned by Leucadia National Corporation. A Business Wire release carried by BOE Report in August 2015 gives 86.8 miles from the Oregon LNG terminal at Warrenton, Oregon to the Northwest Pipeline at Woodland, Washington. FERC issued a draft environmental impact statement on August 5, 2015, under dockets CP09-6 and CP09-7. The pipeline adds well over 25 km of new pipe. The project was withdrawn in April 2016, per the Daily Astorian and Oregon Business. The 36 inch diameter in the scouting note was not found in a page that could be read, so diameter is left blank. Capacity was not found. ProposalYear 2009 is from the docket numbers and is not stated in a source, so check it before applying. Owner name uses the ownership team's short form from the entity lookup. Route not researched. The Williams Northwest Pipeline upgrade in the Washington Expansion Project is separate and not included.
